criteria: A principal tomb, substantial relic or historic pilgrimage makes a stronger anchor than dispersed fragments.
The saint's devotional reach is separate from a relic object's material class, authentication and significance.
No duplicated pin if the same chapel contains several saints or relic pieces.
An existing Place is reused; an unregistered site requires address/coordinate and original sanctuary-link validation before publication.
A historically prominent tomb with uncertain present body custody may warrant pilgrimage context, never an authenticated bodily-relic assertion.
Traditional Passion and Marian sacred objects undergo a separate exceptional-object publication review.
No updated Mass schedules or 1962 feasts are inferred.
research_scope_note: Priority screening and candidate triage; not a comprehensive worldwide relic inventory.
